items.title: File Widerspruch against the contribution assessment
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen die Beitragsfestsetzung ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe möglich; Sie können ihn schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der IKK Nordmuster, Innungsplatz 7, 24539 Musterneumünster, einlegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 01.10.2027 (document_date). As a social-insurance (SGB X) authority letter sent by ordinary post, it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X) → Tue 05.10.2027. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X the day of delivery itself is not counted; the one-month period (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) then runs from 06.10.2027 and ends on the day of the following month numerically corresponding to the delivery day, i.e. Fri 05.11.2027. That day is a business day in NW (no shift needed under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X).

items.title: New freiwillige-Mitgliedschaft contribution rate takes effect
items.quote: Beitragsbescheid für Ihre freiwillige Mitgliedschaft ab 01.11.2027
items.computation: The letter states the new monthly contribution of 451,54 € (Kranken- + Pflegeversicherung) applies starting on the fixed calendar date printed in the heading.

items.title: First direct debit of the new monthly contribution (for November 2027)
items.quote: Den Beitrag buchen wir wie bisher zum 15. des Folgemonats von Ihrem Konto ab.
items.computation: The new rate applies from 01.11.2027. The letter says the contribution is debited 'wie bisher' (as before) on the 15th of the month following the contribution month, so the first debit at the new rate — covering November 2027 — falls on 15 December 2027. 15.12.2027 is a Wednesday, a normal business day, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. This debit then recurs monthly on the 15th of each following month at the same amount unless the income basis changes again.

warnings: The addressee's printed address (Schillerhöhe 5, 73728 Musterlingen am Neckar) is far outside Nordrhein-Westfalen, where the recipient is stated to live; double-check that this Bescheid is actually addressed to the right person/account before acting on it.

The payment clause only confirms a recurring SEPA direct debit from the member's own account ('von Ihrem Konto ab') — no outbound payment or bank-detail change is requested, and the IBAN printed in the letterhead is the insurer's own account, not a transfer target, so there is nothing to pay manually.
